issues.description: Server-side error messages raise APIConnectionError inside recv_task and are swallowed by the broad except.
issues.detail: _process_stream_event raises APIConnectionError on auth_error, quota_exceeded, etc., but recv_task wraps the call in `except Exception: logger.exception(...)` and continues. The dead session keeps spinning. Re-raise APIConnectionError specifically, or set a failure flag and break so _run can reconnect or shut down.

issues.description: audio_format is built by f-string from sample_rate with no validation against the STTAudioFormat literal set.
issues.detail: Passing sample_rate=11025 or 32000 silently produces pcm_11025 which the Literal type forbids and the server rejects. typing.cast hides the type lie. Either validate sample_rate against {8000,16000,22050,24000,44100,48000} at __init__ and raise locally, or drop the duplicated audio_format field and format at the one use site.

issues.description: Reconnect scaffolding is dead code; nothing sets _reconnect_event on task failure.
issues.detail: The outer `while True` only loops when _reconnect_event is set, but no code path sets it. If send_task or recv_task raises, the gather re-raises and _run exits, so a transient network blip kills the stream. Wire reconnect on failure or delete the scaffolding. Also document whether in-flight audio buffers and _speaking state survive a reconnect.

issues.description: Documented parameter ranges are not enforced at construction.
issues.detail: Docstring states vad_silence_threshold_secs in [0.3, 3.0], vad_threshold in [0.1, 0.9], duration fields in [50, 2000], but __init__ performs no validation. Out-of-range values fail opaquely on a server-side WS disconnect. Validate at __init__ and raise ValueError with the documented bounds so the precondition is checked where it is stated.

issues.description: audio_format duplicates sample_rate on STTOptions: two fields, one fact.
issues.detail: audio_format is computed once as f"pcm_{sample_rate}" and stored alongside sample_rate. If a caller mutates one the other lies. Drop audio_format from STTOptions and format it at the single use site in _connect_ws. Also collapse the eleven NotGivenOr ternaries with a small _coalesce helper.

issues.description: No tests added for the streaming state machine.
issues.detail: A stateful WS protocol with partial/committed/empty-commit transitions and a _speaking flag is exactly the code that regresses silently. "Deepgram skipped tests" is not justification. Add a focused unit test that feeds canned WS messages through _process_stream_event and asserts the event sequence, including the empty-commit end-of-segment contract and reconnect behavior.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK but not blocking the shape of the patch. The panel converges on two real bugs: server error events raise APIConnectionError inside recv_task only to be swallowed by a broad except, and the sample_rate-to-audio_format conversion bypasses the type system and will silently produce invalid pcm_ strings. Reconnect scaffolding is dead code because nothing sets _reconnect_event on task failure, and documented parameter ranges are prose-only. Data shape problems (duplicated audio_format, eleven NotGivenOr ternaries, manual query string) and the absence of any test over the streaming state machine round out the consensus. Fix the two P0s, wire or delete reconnect, validate parameters, and add one focused unit test.
